an10.101:1.1: tisso bhikkhave samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti
an10.101:1.3: vevaṇṇiyamhi ajjhupagato parapaṭibaddhā me jīvikā añño me ākappo karaṇīyoti
an10.101:1.4: imā kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā satta dhamme paripūrenti
an10.101:2.2: niccaṃ satatakārī hoti satatavuttī sīlesu anabhijjhālu hoti abyāpajjho hoti anatimānī hoti sikkhākāmo hoti iccatthantissa hoti jīvitaparikkhāresu āraddhaviriyo viharati
an10.101:2.3: ime kho bhikkhave tisso samaṇasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ime satta dhamme paripūrentīti.
